title: Mehrere Straftaten festgestellt – Polizeilicher Staatsschutz ermittelt

extraction.summaryEn: Police found multiple graffiti, including a swastika, on a footpath and removed stickers with unconstitutional symbols from a car. A 23-year-old companion then allegedly threatened and insulted two kiosk workers in a xenophobic manner; the State Protection unit has taken over the investigation.
